about: Canonical referral service taxonomy for the (service, location) model. Two levels: category -> service. Ids of the 7 MODEL_SPEC_v1 gold services and icu are kept; 'aliases' lists the key used in cleaning/claims (lexicon.py, claims.parquet services column). 'coverage' is measured by build_coverage.py (facility counts over the 9,959 usable records; fields = procedure, capability, equipment, description, specialties). Urgency windows and required capabilities are standard clinical guidance summarised by the author for referral routing, not measured and not yet clinically reviewed. Hindi names are the author's and Marathi names are unverified; both need a native-speaker check before use in the app.

services.definition: A round-the-clock emergency department that receives, resuscitates and stabilises injured or acutely ill patients, with surgery or orthopaedics and CT available or arranged.

required_capabilities: doctor on duty round the clock
CT scan on site or within reach
supporting_evidence: emergency beds or triage area with a count
listed in the MoHFW 196 trauma care facilities
contradicting_evidence: single-specialty eye, dental, IVF, skin or AYUSH facility (emergency text there is scoped to that specialty or copied)
ambulance-only text with no emergency department
'refer to', 'transfer to' a higher centre for trauma

coverage_definition: facilities_any: usable records (of 9,959) with a matching claim sentence or a specialties value mapped to the service; facilities_2plus_fields: distinct fields among procedure, capability, equipment, description, specialties after dropping in-record echoes; states_any: distinct state_final; facilities_text_positive: text matches without a non-offer cue and not attributed to another facility; low_coverage: facilities_any < 100 or facilities_2plus_fields < 25. Mentions are claims, not verified offers.

inclusion_rule: A service is in the taxonomy when it is referral-relevant for intermediaries and at least 20 usable records mention it; it is flagged low_coverage below 100 facilities or 25 facilities with 2+ fields.
